crossRefs.note: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of…
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and…
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.

David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies…
Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit…
He answered, “Don’t be afraid; for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
“Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is…
An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested…
Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

translations.web: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
translations.bsb: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
translations.kjv: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many
translations.asv: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many that strove with me.
